info.title: Muraqaba Fleet Maintenance API
info.description:
Ticketing API for bus fleet maintenance with four roles.

**Lifecycle:** sentToVendor → estimateSubmitted ⇄ estimateCountered → pending (with parts and labour filled in) → approved or returned → acknowledged → vehicleSent → vehicleReceived → workInProgress → readyForDelivery → vehicleReleased → vehicleReturned → invoiceSubmitted → invoiceAccepted or invoiceRejected → invoiceReceived → forwardedToPurchase → grnCreated → completed. Oil and transmission with a rate on the bus start at pending. Screens call a ticket a VSR.

**Roles:** serviceCreator manages vendors and buses, raises tickets, fills in parts and labour, sends buses and forwards invoices; supervisor approves tickets and reviews invoices; vendor sends estimates, works on buses, releases them and invoices; purchaseManager makes GRNs, purchase invoices and LPOs and runs queries.

All list endpoints are scoped to what the caller may see. Errors always carry `success: false`, a stable `code` and a human readable `message`.

agreedPrice.description: Fixed at raising, so the VSR goes straight to the vendor to acknowledge (to the supervisor first with supervisorFirst). rate: oil and transmission, the rate on the bus times its interval. lpo: tyres and batteries, the quantity times the LPO line's unit price

lpoLine.description: The LPO line chosen at raising or correction; its amount is booked on it until the GRN. Never sent to vendors.

estimatedAmount.description: The creator's estimate, booked on the LPO line until approval. Never sent to vendors.

bus.description: fleetNumber registrationNumber make model year lifecycle

decisionNote.description: The supervisor's note; the reason when turned down

booked.description: Open VSRs on the line not yet on a GRN

available.description: value - booked - grn: the limit for the next VSR

vsrs.description: VSRs on the line, every status but declined

get.summary: What the bus has cost over its whole life: accepted invoices by kind of work, repairs and accidents counted, current km and cost per km
get.description: Roles: serviceCreator, supervisor, purchaseManager. A VSR costs its current invoice once accepted (as in the cost reports); declined VSRs never count and a no-charge job counts 0. Maintenance is oil (and transmission services), repair is repairs (and brake pads), accident is accident VSRs (and repairs in the Accident category). The current km is the latest daily reading, else the furthest last service. costPerKm = grandTotal / currentKm with four decimals, null with no km.

Multipart form: date (on or after scrappedOn, not in the future), buyer (up to 200 characters), price (AED, 0 or more, 2 decimals), note (up to 1000), attachments. Files go in attachments (PDF, image, Word or Excel; up to 5, 10 MB each). Writes Removed on the daily sheet from the sale day.
